content: Standard 2025/2026 data science portfolio stack: Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion/Motion + Lucide React. Deploy to Vercel (easy) or GitHub Pages (free). For terminal-native aesthetic: 100% monospaced font (JetBrains Mono), warm cream canvas, ASCII bracket markers, no shadows. Content centralized in data files (JSON/TS). Static export for GitHub Pages requires output:'export', images:{unoptimized:true}, trailingSlash:true.
